Venipede

Bug Poison

Unova · Generation 5

Venipede is a Bug/Poison-type Centipede Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 5.3 kg. It evolves into Whirlipede. Its highest base stat is Defense (59), with a base stat total of 260.
